subject: Post-call recap — HelixHealth renewal pulse & dedicated readiness
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Kaur <aisha@helixhealth.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap — HelixHealth renewal pulse & dedicated readiness

Hi Aisha — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side, plus the concrete next steps we discussed.

Key pain points you shared:
- Rising inference costs as RAG usage expanded (search + multi-document synth)
- Latency spikes during morning ET batch processing windows (~100–500 QPS)
- Need for stronger audit logs & data residency assurances for clinical data

Goals we aligned on:
1) Reduce per-token cost by 25–40% for the RAG workload while holding median p95 latency under 300ms.
2) Validate Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and isolation for clinical workloads.
3) Deliver an audit log sample and their retention plan to satisfy the security review.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Helix: share detailed peak-hour request traces and a sample data classification doc (you said you'd send by 11/27).
- Redwood (Monica): provide Q3 usage export + quick Dedicated readiness checklist (attached) by 11/27.
- Redwood (Ben): produce an initial procurement quote for Dedicated (monthly commit tiers + burst) by 11/28.
- Redwood (Jordan): schedule pilot kickoff call and prep success criteria doc by 11/29.

Attachments included in this thread: HelixHealth_usage_report_Q3.pdf (usage summary we referenced), Dedicated_readiness_checklist.xlsx (pilot prerequisites), redwood-procurement-quote.pdf (initial pricing stub).

Open question from the call: would you prefer a 30-day capped pilot on Dedicated or a 60-day pilot with a graded commit? We can map the economics for both.

Proposed next meeting: Pilot kickoff — Tue 12/1 at 10:00 AM ET. If that works I’ll send the calendar invite and agenda.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference for production
From: Aisha Kaur <aisha@helixhealth.io>

Cc: procurement@helixhealth.io
Date: 2026-11-26T12:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — HelixHealth renewal pulse & dedicated readiness

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear notes. Quick replies inline: 

- We’ll share the anonymized peak-hour traces and a short data classification table by Friday (11/27).
- Procurement looped in — procurement@helixhealth.io is our contract lead (they’ll need an SOW + standard DL and retention terms).
- On pilot length: leaning toward a 60-day pilot if we can include an option to convert to a committed tier with a short notice window. Helps us validate stability across two billing cycles.

Two asks from my side before we lock the kickoff: 
1) Can you send a short example SLA and retention language for the audit logs? (we need to pass a security review)
2) A cost example that shows delta between hosted and Dedicated for our 1.2B token Q3 run rate (ballpark is fine)

I’ll confirm the 12/1 time if procurement is available — otherwise we may push to 12/2.

Hi Aisha — attaching the Q3 usage export and our Dedicated readiness checklist as promised. Inline responses: 

- SLA/retention language: see page 2 of Dedicated_readiness_checklist.xlsx — we included a sample audit-log retention commitment (90/180/365-day options) and typical event schemas. Happy to narrow to what your security team requires.
- Ballpark cost delta: attached redwood-procurement-quote.pdf includes three commit tiers (S/M/L) with example per-token deltas. For your current 1.2B tokens Q3 cadence, the mid-tier commit shows ~32% token cost reduction vs hosted.

Attachments: HelixHealth_usage_report_Q3.pdf, Dedicated_readiness_checklist.xlsx, redwood-procurement-quote.pdf

Thanks all — quick confirmation before I send the official invites and the kickoff agenda: 

Confirmed items:
- Helix will send traces + data class by EOD 11/27 (Aisha confirmed).
- Redwood delivered usage report + readiness checklist + pricing stub (attached).
- Proposal: 60-day pilot on Dedicated with a conversion option into a 6- or 12-month commit. We’ll run a mid-pilot check-in at day 30 and tie success to three metrics: 1) sustained p95 latency < 300ms, 2) unit cost reduction >= 25%, 3) audit-log delivery & ingest into your SIEM.

Next actions before kickoff: 
- Ben to circulate an SOW + early-term draft that procurement can review (Ben — can you send that today?).
- Jordan to send calendar invite for Pilot Kickoff (target Tue 12/1 10:00 AM ET) — will include agenda and pre-read.
- Aisha to confirm procurement availability; if unavailable we slide to 12/2 same time.

If that all looks right I’ll push the invite + HubSpot update (deal link included).

Cheers,
